basic_info.description: North Russian Hill Detached Private 2-story cottage surrounded by incredible gardens. Open Living-Dining-Kitchen-Powder with fireplace. Downstairs is a large bedroom with cedar-lined bath + a bonus room that opens onto a secret patio. Behind the bamboo forest at the front is a private patio, plus a 100 square foot garden shed that can be a great home office. Laundry. Abundant storage. Large exclusive parking spot with independent access.
